notes: New horror mod: Arthropod Phobia Expansions (Mods > Converted - off until you turn it on). Realistic spiders, and far too big: recluses, giant huntsmen, tarantulas the size of a horse, the widow, the reaper, crowds of long-legged harvestmen in caves - and the ambusher that waits low and still until you walk right up to it. They come in the dark, and they leap.
They hit hard (3 to 7 hearts) and take a lot of killing. Works in singleplayer and on servers with the HybridHorrorKit plugin; only players who turn it on are hunted.
